_about: Material properties beyond n and k, one entry per key of media.json (and 'air'). Every value carries its source; null means not recorded, and TARANG then asks for your value where it needs one. Read by tarang.media.materials.

air.name: Air
air.n2_source: neglected: several orders of magnitude below any solid core or cladding

si3n4.name: Stoichiometric Si3N4 (LPCVD)
si3n4.n2_source: Ikeda, Saperstein, Alic, Fainman, Opt. Express 16, 12987 (2008); the value used by Ji et al., Optica 4, 619 (2017)

si3n4_hong.name: LPCVD SiN (Hong et al. index)
si3n4_hong.n2_source: Ikeda, Saperstein, Alic, Fainman, Opt. Express 16, 12987 (2008); the value used by Ji et al., Optica 4, 619 (2017)

sio2.name: Fused silica / SiO2
sio2.n2_source: fused silica, as tabulated in 'Platforms for integrated nonlinear optics compatible with silicon integrated circuits', arXiv:1410.7713, Table I note

sio2_nyakuchena.name: Silica glass (Nyakuchena et al. index)
sio2_nyakuchena.n2_source: fused silica, as tabulated in 'Platforms for integrated nonlinear optics compatible with silicon integrated circuits', arXiv:1410.7713, Table I note

si.name: Crystalline silicon (thin SOI film)
si.band_gap_source: crystalline Si, indirect gap at 300 K ('the indirect bandgap is only 1.1 eV', arXiv:1410.7713)

si_franta.name: Float-zone crystalline silicon
si_franta.band_gap_source: crystalline Si, indirect gap at 300 K ('the indirect bandgap is only 1.1 eV', arXiv:1410.7713)

ta2o5.name: Tantala, Ta2O5 (ion-beam sputtered)
ta2o5.n2_source: Jung, Yu, Carlson, Drake, Briles, Papp, Optica 8, 811 (2021), doi:10.1364/OPTICA.411968: 6.2(23) x 10^-19 m^2/W, from the parametric threshold
ta2o5.transparent_source: Black, Streater, Lamee, Carlson, Yu, Papp, Opt. Lett. 46, 817 (2021), Fig. 1(a): absorption low from 320 nm to 8 um

gap.name: Gallium phosphide, GaP (crystalline, 295 K)
gap.n2_source: Wilson et al., Nat. Photonics 14, 57 (2020): 1.1(3) x 10^-17 m^2/W from the parametric threshold (1.2(5) x 10^-17 from four-wave mixing)
gap.dn_dT_source: computed at 1550 nm and 295 K from the temperature-dependent Sellmeier equation of Wei et al., Opt. Mater. Express 8, 485 (2018)
gap.band_gap_source: indirect gap; Wilson et al., Nat. Photonics 14, 57 (2020): negligible two-photon absorption above 1.1 um (direct gap 2.87 eV, Wei et al. 2018)
gap.transparent_source: Wilson et al., Nat. Photonics 14, 57 (2020): transparency from 0.55 to 11 um

al0.2ga0.8as.name: Al0.2Ga0.8As (296 K)
al0.2ga0.8as.n2_source: Chang, Xie, Shu et al., Nat. Commun. 11, 1331 (2020), the value they use for AlGaAs-on-insulator (Pu et al., Optica 3, 823 (2016): 2.6 x 10^-17 for x = 0.17)
al0.2ga0.8as.dn_dT_source: Chang et al., Nat. Commun. 11, 1331 (2020): AlGaAs thermo-optic coefficient 2.3 x 10^-4 /K
al0.2ga0.8as.band_gap_source: direct gap at x = 0.2, 296 K: Gehrsitz et al., J. Appl. Phys. 87, 7825 (2000), Eqs. 11 and 14
